sn55.42:4.3: asaṅkhyeyyo appameyyo → asaṅkheyyo appamyeyyo (bj) | saṅkhyaṁ → saṅkhaṁ (bj, sya-all) | asaṅkhyeyyo → asaṅkheyyo (sya-all)
sn55.42:5.1: yatthimā → S1-3 yatthavā. (pts note) | saṁsandanti → S1-3 sandanti. (pts note)
sn55.42:5.3: udakāḷhakānīti → udakāḷhakāni iti (sya-all) | udakāḷhakasatānīti → udakāḷhakasatāni iti (sya-all) | udakāḷhakasahassānīti → udakāḷhakasahassāni iti (sya-all) | udakāḷhakasatasahassānīti → udakāḷhakasatasahassāni iti (sya-all)
sn55.42:5.4: asaṅkhyeyyo → asaṅkheyyo (bj, sya-all) | mahāudakakkhandhotveva saṅkhyaṁ → mahāudakakkhandho tveva saṅkhaṁ (bj) | saṅkhyaṁ → saṅkhaṁ (sya-all)
sn55.42:5.7: asaṅkhyeyyo → asaṅkheyyo (bj, sya-all) | mahāpuññakkhandhotveva saṅkhyaṁ gacchatīti → mahāpuññakkhandho tveva saṅkhaṁ gacchati (bj) | saṅkhyaṁ → saṅkhaṁ (sya-all)
sn55.42:5.9: satthā → these three words in S1-3 only. (pts note)
sn55.42:6.2: ratanagaṇānamālayaṁ → ratnāgaṇānam ālayaṁ (pts) | ālayaṁ → these two first padas ara not to be found in S1-3. (pts note)
sn55.42:6.4: puthū savantī → puthusavanti hi (pts) | puthusavanti → S1-3 savantī. (pts note) | hi → hi required by metre is in S1-3 and in this sutta only. (pts note)
sn55.42:7.2: seyyāni paccattharaṇassa → seyyānisajjattharaṇassa (sya-all, pts) | seyyānisajjattharaṇassa → as in the preceding sutta. (pts note)
